words: The pink slide rule is wrong. It is not a blanket "under the pink = no longs." It is not a blanket "falling pink = no longs." The pink slide rule only applies in this case: Price has rejected the pink three times on the way down. And pink is in the bottom/top 33% of the channel. Only then are longs/shorts blocked. If price has not rejected the pink three times, the slide does not apply. If price is not in the bottom 33%, the slide does not apply. The inverse is true for shorts: Three rejections off the pink on the way up. And pink in the top 33% of the channel. Only then are shorts blocked. In every other case the slide rule does nothing. Temporarily disable the pink slide rule until I rewrite it. Do not leave the current version in force. Do not change any other rule.
